mainEntity.name: How many trivia questions should a quiz have?

acceptedAnswer.text: 10 to 20 for a meeting round, 30 to 50 for a party, 100 if you’re running a full pub-quiz night. The 100 questions above are organised in rounds of 10 so you can copy whichever rounds fit your time.

mainEntity.name: What’s the difference between trivia and a quiz?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trivia is usually general-knowledge questions with no scoring stakes; a quiz is a scored format. The Formester template runs as a scored quiz so you get a leaderboard automatically; disable scoring if you just want laughs.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find a free printable trivia quiz PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: A printable PDF of the master 100-question list is in the works. In the meantime, the Formester template is the fastest free option that also gives you scoring and a live leaderboard.

mainEntity.name: How do I make my own funny trivia quiz with AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the AI Quiz Maker, paste a topic or upload a PDF, and the model drafts the questions. Review, edit, share. The best AI quiz generators blog compares it to other tools.

mainEntity.name: Can I run a trivia quiz across time zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with a hosted playable quiz. A static list doesn’t work async because people fill it in private and the scores never come back to one place. A Formester link does: send it Monday morning, collect responses by Friday, share the leaderboard on the next all-hands.

mainEntity.name: What’s the best length for a trivia round?

acceptedAnswer.text: 10 questions for a 5-minute round. 20 for a 10-minute round. Past 30 questions in one round, the laughs drop off.

mainEntity.name: Can I embed a Formester trivia quiz inside Notion or Slack canvas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The embed feature ships an iframe or oEmbed snippet that Notion and most intranets render inline.
